title: Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services Unit Conversion and Session Billing Table
content:
The billing desk applies one set of unit and session settings across the six tiers of **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services**.

## Settings by tier

| Tier | Minutes in one timed unit | Conversion of total timed minutes to units | Minimum total timed minutes for one billable unit | Co-treated session (two disciplines together) | Group therapy | Billable treatment visits per discipline per day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | 15 | Eight-minute rule | 8 | Units split between the disciplines | One group session per resident per session | 1 |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | 15 | Eight-minute rule | 8 | Units split between the disciplines | One group session per resident per session | 1 |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | 15 | Eight-minute rule | 8 | Units split between the disciplines | One group session per resident per session | 1 |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | 15 | Eight-minute rule | 8 | Units split between the disciplines | One group session per resident per session | 1 |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | 15 | Eight-minute rule | 8 | Units split between the disciplines | One group session per resident per session | 1 |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | 15 | Eight-minute rule | 8 | Units split between the disciplines | One group session per resident per session | 1 |

## The eight-minute rule

Under the eight-minute rule, 8 to 22 total timed minutes make one unit, 23 to 37 minutes make two units, and each further 15 minutes makes one more unit. Fewer than 8 total timed minutes make no billable unit.

| Total timed minutes | Units |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | None billable |
| 8 to 22 | 1 |
| 23 to 37 | 2 |
| 38 to 52 | 3 |
| 53 to 67 | 4 |
| 68 to 82 | 5 |

## Worked conversions (hypothetical minutes)

- 7 timed minutes: below the 8-minute minimum, no billable unit.
- 22 timed minutes: one unit; 23 timed minutes: two units.
- 44 timed minutes: 37 minutes give two units and the further 7 minutes fall within the next 15-minute step, so three units in all.

## Sessions

- A session two disciplines treat together is billed by splitting its units between the disciplines.
- Group therapy is billed as one group session per resident per session.
- One treatment visit per discipline per day is billable.
